about: Root-cause investigation of the 12 surahs that failed automated validation in Phase 4.1. Evidence only (no audio, no third-party text). docs/audio/failed-recordings-phase-4-2-2026-10-18.md.

yasser-salama:90.originalFailure: structure: a candidate ayah has no length (ayah 13: 52470-52187 ms)
yasser-salama:90.rootCause: CONFIRMED shared defect in flag_boundaries.py boundary placement: 90:13 (فك رقبة, ~1.2 s) is shorter than the snapping window; the longest pause in it was the one AFTER the ayah (52240-52700 ms, 460 ms) rather than the one before it (50600-50980 ms, 380 ms), so 13 started at its own end and 14 had no room. Audio: voiced 51.0-52.3 s between those two pauses.
yasser-salama:90.repair: boundary rule: a start boundary lies after the previous boundary and before the ayah's own aligned end (flag past-own-end); 90:13 moved 52470 -> 50790 ms (inside 50600-50980, 23 dB below the recitation)

validation.checks: flag_boundaries.py 2026-10-18 (Phase 4.1: acoustic depth / reverberation tail, shallow-pause, anchored, extra-audio; Phase 4.2: boundaries kept between the previous boundary and each ayah’s own aligned end)

saleh-talib:86.originalFailure: structure: a candidate ayah has no length (ayah 14: 49850-49804 ms)
saleh-talib:86.rootCause: CONFIRMED same shared defect, verified independently in this file: 86:14 (إنه لقول فصل, ~1.6 s) snapped to the pause after it (49640-50060 ms, 420 ms) instead of the one before it (47820-48100 ms, 280 ms). Audio: voiced 48.1-49.8 s.
saleh-talib:86.repair: same rule; 86:14 moved 49850 -> 47960 ms (inside 47820-48100, 21.6 dB below)

validation.checks: flag_boundaries.py 2026-10-18 (Phase 4.1: acoustic depth / reverberation tail, shallow-pause, anchored, extra-audio; Phase 4.2: boundaries kept between the previous boundary and each ayah’s own aligned end)

sharedDefectAlsoCorrected: saleh-talib:80 (9: joined ayahs, no pause; aligned onset used, shallow, flagged)
structural.regression: re-flagging all 441 candidates changed exactly these 8 surahs; the 14 reference surahs (554 boundaries) are byte-identical; alignment/test_flag_boundaries.py fails without the rule and passes with it

54.originalFailure: text not confirmed: median character score 0.152 (wrong-text controls 0.17-0.18)
54.rootCause: NOT CONFIRMED. Established: two independent recognisers cannot read the file (MMS forced alignment scores at the wrong-text level; a Quran-trained Whisper ranks the expected surah #46 of 114 and recognises 8/55 ayahs). Rejected by experiment (on surah 98 and clean recordings of the same surah): band-limiting to 2 kHz, restoration-style gating, both together, pitch shift, search window length. Observed but not sufficient on its own: 38% digital silence (200 runs), energy above 2 kHz -24 dB.
54.contentIndications: recognised fragments mostly advance through the expected surah, with jumps (weak evidence the content is the expected surah)
54.classification: not repairable automatically: requires a replacement recording (a cleaner transfer of the same Rifaat recording) or timing made by a listener; stays out of the review queue
